title: 第3章 传闻有误
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
那位被称作小剑仙的萧京溪!

    即便季南北穿越来此时日尚短，又身处偏僻的魔宗山野，对这名字也并非一无所闻。其声名之显赫，由此可见。

    传闻她六岁练气，七岁筑基，十二岁时便已金丹入腹，颇有几分“我命由我不由天“的意味。人尚在世，事迹却已快被传成神话。

    传说这位小剑仙剑术通神，一柄玉剑能斩落天外星辰。

    传说这位小剑仙姿容绝世，宛若九天仙子谪落凡尘。

    传说这位小剑仙性情淡泊，一心向道，不染俗世纷扰。

    前两条传闻，以眼下观之，非但毫不夸张，甚至流传得还有些保守了。但这第三条......

    “那个......你究竟是何人?为何要占据我的身躯?“

    悦耳的女声再度响起，只是语气里透着一丝不易察觉的怯意。

    季南北正思忖着如何应答，系统面板却倏然弹出。

    [任务触发，请从下列三条选项中择一回复。]

    选项一：本大爷行不更名坐不改姓，季南北是也!实话实说，我就是看上你这副身躯了!!(奖励五十万魔道点，七品至宝琉璃镜。)

    选项二：本座乃魔道巨擘，此番便是要夺你仙躯，重振魔道声威，杀尽尔等虚伪正道!(奖励十万魔道点，五品功法《阴阳反转诀》。)

    选项三：我为何定要告知于你?(奖励三千魔道点，筑基丹一枚。)

    不得不承认，前两个选项的诱惑力确实惊人。

    暂且不论魔道点数，单是那灵宝与功法，便已是天大的机缘。

    此方世界，功法与灵宝皆分九品，一品为末，九品至高。

    一至三品谓之凡宝，四至六品方可称灵宝，七品之上方能唤作至宝，至于更高层次的，则基本是只存于传说中的仙宝了。

    功法品阶划分也大抵如此。

    季南北眼下所学的功法，都还是些不入流的货色。

    无论是七品至宝，还是五品功法，对他而言都是难以抗拒的诱惑。尽管这五品功法的名字听起来有些古怪。

    正当季南北这般思量时，系统贴心地弹出了《阴阳反转》的简介。

    阴阳反转诀：阴阳交合宗秘传法门。

    功法简介：雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌!

    季南北：???

    当他心中浮现问号时，并非他自身存在疑问，而是觉得这系统大有蹊跷!

    总而言之，尽管宝物诱人，季南北最终还是选择了第三项。

    毕竟，选择第一项会暴露身份，届时以仙剑宗的势力......季南北恐怕连明天的太阳都见不着了。

    而第二项，虽未暴露身份，但被这身躯的原主强行弹出却是必然。
content_en:
That Xiao Jingxi who is called the Little Sword Fairy!

    Even though Ji Nanbei traveled back in time and was still in the remote Mozong Mountains, he had not heard of this name. Its great reputation can be seen from this.

    It is said that she practiced qi at the age of six, built her foundation at the age of seven, and had the golden elixir in her belly at the age of twelve. It is quite a bit like "I can't control my destiny". While the man is still alive, his deeds are almost becoming legends.

    Legend has it that this little sword fairy is a master of swordsmanship, and a jade sword can cut down stars from the sky.

    Legend has it that this little sword fairy has a peerless appearance, just like a fairy from the Nine Heavens who has been banished to the mortal world.

    Legend has it that this little swordsman has an indifferent temperament, is devoted to the Tao, and is untainted by the troubles of the world.

    The first two rumors, judging from the current situation, are not only no exaggeration, but are even a bit conservative. But the third one...

    "Um...who are you? Why do you want to take over my body?"

    The sweet female voice sounded again, but there was a hint of timidity in her tone that was not easily noticeable.

    Ji Nanbei was thinking about how to respond when the system panel suddenly popped up.

    [The task is triggered, please choose one of the following three options to reply. ]

    Option 1: I can’t change my name, but I can’t change my surname. Ji Nanbei is the same! To be honest, I just like your body!! (Reward 500,000 magic points, seventh-grade treasure glazed mirror.)

    Option 2: I am a giant of the Demonic Way, and this time I want to seize your immortal body, revive the reputation of the Demonic Way, and kill all of you who are hypocritical and righteous! (Reward 100,000 Demonic Way Points, and the fifth-level skill "Yin-Yang Reversal Technique".)

    Option 3: Why do I have to tell you? (Reward 3,000 magic points and a Foundation Establishment Pill.)

    I have to admit that the first two options are really tempting.

    Regardless of the magic points for the moment, the spiritual treasures and techniques alone are already a huge opportunity.

    In this world, skills and spiritual treasures are divided into nine levels, with the first level being the lowest and the ninth level being the highest.

    The first to third grades are called ordinary treasures, the fourth to sixth grades can be called spiritual treasures, and those above seventh grade can be called supreme treasures. As for the higher levels, they are basically fairy treasures that only exist in legends.

    The classification of skills and grades is roughly the same.

    The techniques that Ji Nanbei is currently learning are still inferior.

    Whether it is a seventh-grade treasure or a fifth-grade technique, it is an irresistible temptation for him. Although the name of this fifth level skill sounds a bit weird.

    Just as Ji Nanbei was thinking about this, the system thoughtfully popped up the introduction to "Yin and Yang Reversal".

    Yin-Yang Reversal Technique: The secret method of Yin-Yang Interaction Sect.

    Introduction to the technique: The male rabbit's feet are twitching, and the female rabbit's eyes are blurred; two rabbits are walking next to each other on the ground, and they can tell whether I am male or female!

    Ji Nanbei:???

    When a question mark appeared in his mind, it was not that he had doubts about himself, but that there was something fishy about the system!

    All in all, despite the temptation of the treasure, Ji Nanbei finally chose the third option.

    After all, choosing the first option would reveal his identity, and with the power of the Immortal Sword Sect... Ji Nanbei might not even be able to see the sun tomorrow.

    As for the second item, although the identity is not revealed, it is inevitable that the original owner of this body will be forcibly ejected.
